This repository currently exposes no independently authored JSON/HTTP data contract that should be admitted through TypeSpec + JSON Schema. Do not invent a TJSV contract for the in-process launcher API. If a cross-runtime serialized control surface is added, move that surface to an appropriate `*-interfaces` authority and gate its independently authored TypeSpec and Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema with ORESoftware/typespec-json-schema-validator.
